Today we’re hitting a 100-mile stretch from the working-class town of Cortez to high mountain Telluride, one of the most expensive towns in the country. In this stretch, the socioeconomic and scenic differences are massive. Join me as we meet many cool locals along the way in one of the most beautiful parts of the country.
